operator_decisions.title: Full adoption of the 2026-08-28 Consolidated Partner Review Pack as the Tier 3 baseline
operator_decisions.decision: The Pack supersedes the Master Draft concept wholesale: new title/framing ('From Plant Water-Stress Signatures to Transferable Irrigation Decision Support for High-Value Horticulture'), WP1-WP5 restructure, unnamed farmer validation site, Skanzen contingency, MVCRI post-MSCA, DrR background/IP doctrine, Krumatic dev-from-M1, mainly-remote placement, teaching route via MATE + AU Plovdiv, evidence-based impact magnitude.

operator_decisions.title: Ethics self-assessment (re-anchored to ATK)
operator_decisions.gate: phase_06_gate predicate g07_p06 requires a non-empty ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement in the Phase 6 output.

decision.personal_data_gdpr: Yes, limited. The DrR web MVP holds user accounts and farm contact details; field boundaries tied to a named holding are personal data for a natural-person farmer. The beneficiary's (HUN-REN ATK's) data-protection function reviews the processing and data minimisation applies.
decision.farmer_commercial_data: Yes. Yields, irrigation records and field geometries from the commercial farmer site and AgroVIR extracts are commercially sensitive. Data-sharing arrangements govern them; results are published only in aggregated, coded or anonymised form (the Pack's 'Field X' pattern).
decision.human_participants: Yes, low risk. WP5 evaluation (T5.1) and grower requirements work involve structured feedback from AgroVIR staff and participating farmers. Informed consent and a right of withdrawal apply. No health, biometric or special-category data is collected.
decision.animal_subjects: No. The project studies processing tomato.
decision.dual_use_and_misuse: No. Civil agricultural decision support on open Copernicus data.
decision.non_eu_data_transfer: No. All data stays within the EU (Hungary and Bulgaria).
decision.ethics_committee_approval_required: Not yet determined. The HUN-REN ATK research-ethics route will be consulted on the human-feedback tasks before fieldwork begins; expectation is that structured usability feedback under informed consent falls below the review threshold. To be confirmed in writing by M12.
decision.data_protection_officer_consulted: Planned. The HUN-REN ATK Data Protection Officer (or the competent HUN-REN DPO function) will be consulted before the first DrR web-MVP user account is created: lawful basis for farm contact details and field boundaries, retention, minimisation.

operator_decisions.consequence: ethics_issues_identified is true, so Part A's ethics table and Part B-2 §6 must both be completed. RE-ANCHORING (2026-08-28): every ELTE body named in the 2026-08-11 decision is restated for ATK's equivalents; naming the specific ATK committee/DPO is collected with ATK's written confirmation and until then the function, not a body name, is stated. See decision_log/fieldwise-run02-supersessions_2026-08-28.json.

operator_decisions.title: Security screening and Green Charter statements

decision.security_screening: No concerns arise. The project handles no classified or EU-restricted information; open Copernicus data and institutional field measurements; no dual-use goods or technology; no entity established outside the EU (ATK, ELTE, MATE, AgroVIR in Hungary; Krumatic, MVCRI in Bulgaria).
green_charter: Reuse before regeneration: the 2022-2026 MATE archive is the primary data source rather than a new campaign; the single new instrumented site is the minimum the prospective-validation logic requires.
Prefer the simplest adequate model; the Pack's parsimony principle is explicit (no deep-learning dependency).
Run computation on shared HUN-REN infrastructure rather than provisioning dedicated hardware.
Travel: default to remote collaboration — the placement itself is mainly remote with monthly face-to-face meetings; shared transport for field campaigns.
Conferences: hybrid attendance by default, at most one in-person conference per year.
Purpose: better irrigation timing serves the Charter's environmental aim directly.
